summary.headline: Codex C: Astronomy and Miscellany
summary.text: Description of 16th-century Codex C, VI, 21, whose first section presents an instructional compendium of music and astronomy, including the zodiac, eclipses, ecliptic nodes, planets, configurations, stellar mixtures, planetary houses, exaltations, climates, and solar transitions. Later contents include Heron on geometry, Hippocrates on prognostication, theft divination, Oppian on marine animals, Synesius, and astrological and phlebotomy excerpts.
